verdict.rationale: Swell offers official Node and PHP API libraries, an official CLI (confirmed runnable via npm), and documented backend/webhook/functions APIs that AI-native builders can target; agent-specific skills/markdown contracts and schema-introspection endpoints further support AI-native building patterns. Missing for 10: no official SDKs beyond Node/PHP (e.g., Python, Go), no public OpenAPI spec or llms.txt (probes returned 404s) for machine-readable API discovery.
